title_ar: جواز صرف الزكاة للمؤسسات التعليمية والدعوية
title_en: The Permissibility of Disbursing Zakat to Educational and Daʿwah Institutions
body_ar: فتوى بجواز صرف الزكاة للمؤسسات التعليمية والدعوية والتصرف فيها بما تقتضيه المصلحة العامة
body_en: A considered legal opinion (fatwā) that it is permissible to disburse zakat to educational institutions and to institutions that call people to Islam (daʿwah), and to dispose of it in accordance with what the public benefit (maṣlaḥah) requires.

But the page text is a one-line caption under a scanned image; the signed fatwā itself, with its wording, its reasoning and any conditions, exists only as the image 'fatwawekate.jpg'. The scan must be read and translated before this displays as the Sheikh's fatwā, because the caption gives the conclusion without the conditions on which it rests.

options: disbursing zakat to educational and daʿwah institutions
spending zakat on educational and daʿwah institutions
channelling zakat through educational and daʿwah institutions
flags.note: Whether the institutions are recipients of zakat in their own right or conduits to eligible recipients is precisely the point the eight categories entitled to zakat (maṣārif al-zakāh, Sūrat al-Tawbah 9:60) turn on, and the caption does not settle it. The neutral 'disbursing … to' is used. This bears directly on how the ruling would be applied and must not be resolved from the caption alone.
Rendered on the fixed mapping. Note that جواز here is a legal ruling about an act, not the kalām sense of rational possibility (style guide §8), so the five-rulings mapping is the right one to apply.
